name: Rabbit Bullet Holes
description: Edgy street art style rabbit with bullet holes in ears

visual_style.dimension: professional photograph with gritty urban aesthetic, depth of field with flag in background
visual_style.texture: detailed fur texture, realistic bullet hole damage, weathered flag fabric, urban surfaces
visual_style.detail_level: high quality photography with sharp detail on rabbit, flag slightly blurred in background
visual_style.composition: layered composition with rabbit in foreground and striped flag hanging behind, street art meets wildlife photography

dos: White or grey rabbit as main subject in foreground
Bullet holes visible through both ears with realistic damage
Small blood stains around bullet holes
Sharp focus on rabbit face and ears
Striped flag visible in background behind rabbit
Flag should be out of focus or slightly blurred
Gritty urban or street art aesthetic
Weathered concrete or urban texture visible
Rabbit should look defiant or tough, not sad
Realistic fur texture with individual hairs visible
Flag stripes in red, white, and black or other bold colors
donts: No dead or suffering animal - rabbit should look alive and tough
